cues.text: An 18-year-old man has a deep stab wound to the front of his left forearm.
It is a deep, penetrating injury to the anterior forearm.
Several muscles lie here in the front of the forearm, each with its own nerve supply.
This yellow nerve, running down the forearm, is the ulnar nerve.
It supplies this muscle, flexor carpi ulnaris.
So flexor carpi ulnaris is the forearm muscle supplied by the ulnar nerve.
